description: Phase 5: damage model and block-safe explosions, Dirt Racing, Wanted Racing with police bots/heat/bust. Depends on FEAT-004.
steps: Read .agents/inbox.md, then implement plan.md items 5.1-5.4 in order exactly as written in /projects/sandbox/Forzacraft/.agents/tasks/forzacraft/plan.md (files, behaviour, verification per item).
After each completed item: run its Verify command, then git add the specific files, commit (conventional message) and git push origin main.
Any point needing a user decision: append a question to .agents/questions.md, send_message severity 'info', mark the item DEFERRED (Qn) in plan.md, continue with other items.

Finish with the Phase 5 DONE CHECK: bash tools/ci/done-check.sh (and COMPAT=server bash tools/ci/server-smoke.sh where the plan says so); record command outputs summary, test counts, screenshot paths in findings.
acceptance_criteria: GameTest: crash damage, explosion at 0 health leaves every block in a 7x7x7 box unchanged and damages nearby entity
GameTest: police pursue, stopped racer busted, heat rises
police car screenshot viewed; DONE CHECK passes
